name: Vet Billing - Payment Plans
description: Interest-free vet payment plans at participating clinics (approval set by each clinic)
fullDescription: VetBilling offers interest-free installment payment plans through participating veterinary clinics, with a searchable directory of clinics that use it.
whatTheyOffer:
- Directory of participating vets that offer VetBilling payment plans
- Interest-free installments paid by automatic withdrawal from a bank account or card
- No penalty for paying off early
- Each clinic sets its own eligibility; some may do a soft credit check or require two payment methods
howToGetIt:
1. Visit vetbilling.com/find-vet and search by location
2. Contact a participating clinic directly (especially if you are not a current client)
3. Ask the clinic if you qualify for a payment plan
4. Set up the plan at the clinic (plans cannot be set up on the website)
keywords: Vet Billing, payment plan, vet financing, pay over time, veterinary credit, afford vet bill, installment
